en: Brought into life; or a natural ability someone has from birth.
ex: She was born in Taipei in 1995.
她於1995年出生於台北。

en: To take something from someone with the promise to give it back later.
ex: Can I borrow your pen for a minute?
我可以借你的筆用一下嗎？

en: The person who is in charge of a workplace or the people who work there.
ex: My boss wants the report by Friday.
我的老闆要我星期五前交報告。

en: Used to talk about two people or things together.
ex: Both of my parents are teachers.
我的父母都是老師。

en: A container with a narrow neck, usually made of glass or plastic, for liquids.
ex: She bought a bottle of water from the shop.
她從店裡買了一瓶水。

en: The lowest part of something; or the lowest position.
ph: from the bottom of one's heart
ex: The keys are at the bottom of my bag.
鑰匙在我包包的底部。

en: To bend your body forward to show respect; or a knot of ribbon; or a weapon for shooting arrows.
ex: The actors bowed to the audience at the end of the play.
演出結束時，演員們向觀眾鞠躬。

en: A deep, round dish used for food or liquid.
ex: He ate a big bowl of noodles for lunch.
他午餐吃了一大碗麵。

en: A container with straight sides and a lid, used for storing things; or to fight with fists as a sport.
ex: She put the toys back in the box.
她把玩具放回盒子裡。

en: A male child or young man.
ex: The boy is playing football in the yard.
那個男孩在院子裡踢足球。

en: Ready to face danger, pain or difficulty without showing fear.
ex: The brave firefighter saved the child from the fire.
那位勇敢的消防員從火場中救出了孩子。

en: A common food made from flour and water that is baked.
ex: I have bread and eggs for breakfast.
我早餐吃麵包和蛋。

en: To damage something so that it divides into pieces; or a short rest; or to stop doing something.
ex: Don't break the glass; it is very expensive.
別打破那個玻璃杯，它很貴。

en: The first meal of the day, eaten in the morning.
ex: I have toast and milk for breakfast.
我早餐吃吐司配牛奶。

en: A structure built over a river or road so people can cross; or to connect two things or groups.
ex: We walked across the old stone bridge.
我們走過那座古老的石橋。

en: Giving out a lot of light; or very clever; or having a strong, clear color.
ex: The sun is bright today.
今天陽光很亮。

en: To carry or take something or someone to a place; or to cause something to happen.
ex: Please bring your book to class tomorrow.
明天請把你的書帶到課堂上。

en: A boy or man who has the same parents as you.
ex: My brother is two years older than me.
我哥哥比我大兩歲。

en: The color of earth, wood or coffee.
ex: She has long brown hair and brown eyes.
她有一頭棕色長髮和棕色眼睛。

en: A small insect; or a mistake in a computer program; or a small device for secretly listening.
ex: There is a bug in the program that makes it crash.
這個程式有個錯誤，會讓它當機。

en: To make something by putting parts together; or to develop something over time.
ex: They are building a new school in our town.
他們正在我們鎮上蓋一所新學校。

en: A large vehicle that carries many passengers along a fixed route.
ex: I take the bus to school every morning.
我每天早上搭公車上學。

en: The activity of buying and selling goods or services; or a company that does this.
ex: Her father runs a small business in town.
她父親在鎮上經營一家小生意。

en: Having a lot of things to do; or full of activity.
ex: I am busy with my homework right now.
我現在正忙著寫功課。

en: Used to show a contrast; or to mean except.
ex: I wanted to go, but it was raining.
我想去，但是在下雨。

en: A soft yellow food made from cream, used on bread or in cooking.
ex: She spread butter on her toast.
她在吐司上塗奶油。

en: A flying insect with large, colorful wings.
ex: A butterfly landed on the flower.
一隻蝴蝶停在花上。

en: A small, round object sewn on clothes to fasten them; or a part you press to operate a machine.
ex: Press the green button to start the machine.
按下綠色按鈕來啟動機器。

en: To get something by paying money for it.
ex: I want to buy a new pair of shoes.
我想買一雙新鞋。

en: Next to or near something; or used to show who or what does something; or not later than a time.
ex: The cat is sitting by the window.
貓坐在窗邊。

en: A sweet food made by baking a mixture of flour, eggs, sugar and butter.
ex: We had a birthday cake with candles.
我們有一個插著蠟燭的生日蛋糕。

en: To speak to someone by telephone; or to shout to get attention; or to name something; or a short visit.
ex: Please call me when you arrive.
你到的時候請打電話給我。

en: A device for taking photographs or recording moving pictures.
ex: She took a photo with her new camera.
她用新相機拍了一張照片。

en: A place where people live or stay in tents for a short time; or to sleep outdoors in a tent.
ex: We set up camp near the lake.
我們在湖邊搭營地。

en: To be able to do something; or a metal container for food or drink.
ex: I can speak English and French.
我會說英語和法語。

en: A soft flat hat with a curved front; or a cover for the top of a bottle or pen.
ex: He wore a red cap to keep the sun out.
他戴了一頂紅帽子遮陽。

en: A road vehicle with an engine and four wheels that carries a few people.
ex: My father drives a car to work.
我爸爸開車上班。

en: A piece of stiff paper with information or a message on it; or one of a set used for playing games.
ex: She sent me a birthday card.
她寄給我一張生日卡。

en: To look after someone or something; or to feel that something is important; or serious attention.
ex: She takes good care of her younger brother.
她好好照顧她的弟弟。

en: Thinking about what you are doing to avoid mistakes or danger.
ex: Be careful when you cross the street.
過馬路時要小心。
